interpretation: Zero IDSW is not interpreted alone. High global and per-video identity scores, 24 transient wrong-ID animal-frames, no terminal episodes, and no persistent swaps support continuity. The large standard fragment count is primarily a detection/localization-gap signal; the supplementary 15-frame gap-tolerant count is small.
limitation: The gap-tolerant fragment statistic comes from the same historical prediction artifact under the legacy supplementary continuity report, not from the Standard V2 headline metric.
